identity.title: Add overview and problems read API

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Expose fleet overview and problem groups through read-only HTTP endpoints with simple time/source query parameters. Keep calculation in analytics/problems services rather than handlers. Dependency: 8020.add-problem-aggregation.
human_pressure.why_now: The console needs stable aggregate endpoints before frontend implementation.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add GET overview/problems endpoints backed by deterministic analytics services.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8020.add-problem-aggregation. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
API is a product read surface.
failure_semantics: Invalid filters return deterministic client error rather than silent fallback to all data.

steps.title: Add problem list/detail endpoints
details: Return group summaries and affected run IDs/evidence-linked signal detail.

steps.title: Keep handlers thin
details: No duplicated aggregation SQL in handler.

acceptance: GET overview returns deterministic aggregate DTO.
GET problems supports list and drill-down.
No write endpoint/auth platform is introduced.

must_check: Aggregation logic is not duplicated in HTTP layer.
reject_if: Handlers parse raw evidence or EverRun files directly.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Server analytics endpoint tests plus existing execution-view server regression.
